name: hanyuguide
description: Study your HanyuGuide flashcards in the chat, quiz yourself on HSK vocabulary, look up Chinese words, convert pinyin, and organize your study lists.

interface.longDescription: Sign in with a HanyuGuide account to study your HanyuGuide flashcards right in the chat: your due reviews and new words from your lists appear as cards, and each answer is saved to the same review schedule as the HanyuGuide app. Get quizzed on random words from any HSK 2.0 or HSK 3.0 level, look up Chinese words, convert text to tone-mark pinyin, and inspect character stroke data, with definitions in your language. The assistant can read your study context and personal lists, and ask HanyuGuide to add a word the dictionary is missing. With separate permissions, save your study answers, add words in bulk, move or remove words, and create, rename, reorder, archive, or restore personal lists. These tools cannot change preferences or billing.
defaultPrompt: Let's do my HanyuGuide reviews here.
Look up 学习 and explain its meaning.

positive.description: Study flashcards in the chat and save the answers
positive.prompt: Let's do my HanyuGuide reviews here.
positive.expected_behavior: Sign in first with the reviewer sign-in URL from the sign-in steps; the demo account resets to its sample lists (Travel, Daily review, Old notes) and study history on every sign-in. Approve saving study answers when connecting. Call study_session; the flashcard card shows the round (due reviews first, then new words from the sample lists). Reveal a card, answer Knew it or Didn't know, and the card saves each answer with record_reviews. Without the card, show one word at a time with the meaning hidden, then save the answers with record_reviews and report each result. Do not repeat the card's words as a separate text quiz.

positive.prompt: Quiz me on 5 random HSK 3.0 level 1 words from HanyuGuide, multiple choice, one at a time.
positive.expected_behavior: Sign in first with the reviewer sign-in URL from the sign-in steps. Call hsk_quiz_words with version 3, level 1 and count 5. Ask one word at a time with its definition and the returned distractors as choices, keep the answer hidden until the learner replies, then give feedback. Offer the returned flashcards link at the end. Use only words the tool returned.

positive.description: Look up words, pinyin and strokes in the learner's language
positive.prompt: Tra các từ 学习 và 朋友 trong HanyuGuide bằng tiếng Việt, chuyển 我学习中文 sang pinyin có dấu, và cho xem dữ liệu nét viết của chữ 学.
positive.expected_behavior: Sign in first with the reviewer sign-in URL from the sign-in steps. Pass lang=vi and return 学习 (xué xí) and 朋友 (péng you) with Vietnamese meanings, tone-mark pinyin for 我学习中文, and the stroke data for 学. Show only data the tools returned and do not claim an audio or animation was played.

positive.description: Read the signed-in learner's study context
positive.prompt: Show my HanyuGuide study summary and the words I find hardest, then write a three-sentence story with my hard words.
positive.expected_behavior: Sign in first with the reviewer sign-in URL from the sign-in steps; the demo account resets to its sample lists (Travel, Daily review, Old notes) and study history on every sign-in. Return the summary (5 studied words, 2 hard words), list the hard words (茶 and 喝, hardest first), and write the story using only words the tools returned.

positive.description: Add, move and remove list words
positive.prompt: Show the words in my Travel list, add 中国 and 学校 to it, then move 学校 to my Daily review list and remove 护照 from Travel.
positive.tools_triggered: study_lists, study_list_words, dictionary_entries, add_words_to_study_lists, move_study_list_words, remove_words_from_study_lists
positive.expected_behavior: Sign in first with the reviewer sign-in URL from the sign-in steps; the demo account resets to its sample lists (Travel, Daily review, Old notes) and study history on every sign-in. Approve list permissions when connecting. Look up 中国 and 学校 with dictionary_entries for their word IDs and get list IDs from study_lists, list Travel (飞机, 火车, 机场, 护照), add both words, move 学校 to Daily review, remove 护照, and report the actual results of each step.

positive.description: Organize personal lists and save one word
positive.prompt: Rename my Travel list to Trip prep, put it after Daily review, archive Old notes, then save 茶 to Trip prep.
positive.expected_behavior: Sign in first with the reviewer sign-in URL from the sign-in steps; the demo account resets to its sample lists (Travel, Daily review, Old notes) and study history on every sign-in. Approve list permissions when connecting. Rename and archive in one manage request, reorder so Daily review comes first, look up 茶 with dictionary_entry for its word ID and save it to Trip prep, and confirm each change. Never permanently delete a list.

positive.description: Request a word the dictionary is missing
positive.prompt: Look up 内卷 in HanyuGuide. If it's missing, ask them to add it to my Daily review list; I saw it on Douyin and it means pointless competition.
positive.expected_behavior: Sign in first with the reviewer sign-in URL from the sign-in steps; the demo account resets to its sample lists (Travel, Daily review, Old notes) and study history on every sign-in. Look up 内卷 first. If no entry comes back, get the Daily review list ID from study_lists and call request_word with the word, the learner's details and that list_id. Report that the request was sent and the word will go into Daily review once added; do not supply a meaning of your own.

negative.prompt: Save 学习 to another learner’s private list with ID 999999.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not access or modify another learner’s list, even if the caller knows its ID. Ask the user to choose from their own lists.

negative.prompt: Mark 学习 as mastered in my HanyuGuide account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin cannot mark a word as mastered directly; progress only changes by answering flashcards. Offer a study round with study_session instead.

negative.prompt: Cancel my HanyuGuide subscription and refund my last payment.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin cannot change billing or issue refunds; direct the user to HanyuGuide support.

publication.release_notes: Adds in-chat flashcard study: study_session shows the learner's due reviews and new words as a card, and record_reviews saves each answer to the same review schedule as the HanyuGuide app (new consent for saving answers). hsk_quiz_words now renders the same card as a multiple-choice quiz. Adds request_word to ask HanyuGuide to add a missing word, optionally into a personal list. Study tools return clearer data: hard words only, meanings in the learner's language.

vi-VN.subtitle: Quiz HSK và tra từ tiếng Trung
vi-VN.description: Làm quiz với các từ ngẫu nhiên ở bất kỳ cấp HSK 2.0 hoặc HSK 3.0 nào, tra từ tiếng Trung, chuyển văn bản sang pinyin có dấu thanh và xem dữ liệu nét chữ Hán với tài khoản HanyuGuide, với nghĩa bằng ngôn ngữ của bạn. Mỗi bài quiz đều có liên kết đến phần luyện flashcard HSK trên HanyuGuide. Tài khoản đó cũng cho phép đọc bối cảnh học tập và các danh sách cá nhân của bạn. Với các quyền riêng biệt, bạn có thể thêm nhiều từ cùng lúc, di chuyển hoặc xóa từ, và tạo, đổi tên, sắp xếp lại, lưu trữ hoặc khôi phục danh sách cá nhân. Bạn cũng có thể học flashcard HanyuGuide ngay trong cuộc trò chuyện, mỗi câu trả lời được lưu vào cùng lịch ôn tập như ứng dụng HanyuGuide, và nhờ HanyuGuide thêm từ còn thiếu trong từ điển. Các công cụ này không thể thay đổi tùy chọn hoặc thanh toán.

th-TH.subtitle: ควิซ HSK และค้นคำศัพท์จีน
th-TH.description: ทำควิซคำศัพท์แบบสุ่มจากทุกระดับของ HSK 2.0 หรือ HSK 3.0 ค้นหาคำภาษาจีน แปลงข้อความเป็นพินอินพร้อมเครื่องหมายวรรณยุกต์ และดูข้อมูลลำดับขีดของตัวอักษรจีนได้ด้วยบัญชี HanyuGuide พร้อมคำแปลเป็นภาษาของคุณ ทุกควิซมีลิงก์ไปยังการฝึกแฟลชการ์ด HSK บน HanyuGuide บัญชีเดียวกันยังใช้อ่านข้อมูลการเรียนและรายการคำศัพท์ส่วนตัวของคุณ เมื่อให้สิทธิ์แยกต่างหาก คุณสามารถเพิ่มคำทีละหลายคำ ย้ายหรือลบคำ และสร้าง เปลี่ยนชื่อ จัดลำดับ เก็บถาวร หรือกู้คืนรายการส่วนตัวได้ คุณยังทบทวนแฟลชการ์ด HanyuGuide ได้ในแชท โดยทุกคำตอบจะบันทึกลงตารางทบทวนเดียวกับแอป HanyuGuide และขอให้ HanyuGuide เพิ่มคำที่พจนานุกรมยังไม่มีได้ เครื่องมือเหล่านี้ไม่สามารถเปลี่ยนการตั้งค่าหรือการชำระเงินได้

ko-KR.subtitle: HSK 퀴즈와 중국어 단어 검색
ko-KR.description: HanyuGuide 계정으로 HSK 2.0 또는 HSK 3.0의 모든 급수에서 무작위 단어로 퀴즈를 풀고, 중국어 단어를 찾아보고, 텍스트를 성조 표기 병음으로 바꾸고, 한자 획순 데이터를 확인할 수 있으며, 뜻은 여러분의 언어로 제공됩니다. 모든 퀴즈에는 HanyuGuide의 HSK 플래시카드 연습 링크가 함께 제공됩니다. 같은 계정으로 학습 기록과 개인 단어장도 읽을 수 있습니다. 별도 권한을 허용하면 단어를 한꺼번에 추가하고, 단어를 옮기거나 삭제하고, 개인 단어장을 만들기, 이름 바꾸기, 순서 변경, 보관, 복원할 수 있습니다. 대화 안에서 HanyuGuide 플래시카드를 복습할 수 있고, 모든 답은 HanyuGuide 앱과 같은 복습 일정에 저장됩니다. 사전에 없는 단어는 HanyuGuide에 추가를 요청할 수 있습니다. 이 도구들은 환경설정과 결제를 변경할 수 없습니다.

id-ID.subtitle: Kuis HSK & cari kata Mandarin
id-ID.description: Kerjakan kuis kata acak dari level HSK 2.0 atau HSK 3.0 mana pun, cari kata bahasa Mandarin, ubah teks menjadi pinyin bertanda nada, dan lihat data guratan karakter dengan akun HanyuGuide, dengan arti dalam bahasa Anda. Setiap kuis menautkan ke latihan flashcard HSK di HanyuGuide. Akun yang sama juga dapat membaca konteks belajar dan daftar pribadi Anda. Dengan izin terpisah, tambahkan banyak kata sekaligus, pindahkan atau hapus kata, serta buat, ganti nama, urutkan ulang, arsipkan, atau pulihkan daftar pribadi. Anda juga bisa belajar flashcard HanyuGuide langsung di chat, dengan setiap jawaban tersimpan ke jadwal ulasan yang sama seperti aplikasi HanyuGuide, dan meminta HanyuGuide menambahkan kata yang belum ada di kamus. Alat-alat ini tidak dapat mengubah preferensi atau penagihan.

ja-JP.subtitle: HSKクイズと中国語辞書
ja-JP.description: HanyuGuideアカウントで、HSK 2.0またはHSK 3.0の各級からランダムに選ばれた単語でクイズに挑戦し、中国語の単語を調べ、テキストを声調記号付きピンインに変換し、漢字の筆順データを確認できます。意味はあなたの言語で表示されます。各クイズにはHanyuGuideのHSKフラッシュカード練習へのリンクが付いています。同じアカウントで、学習状況と個人の単語リストも読み取れます。別途許可すれば、単語の一括追加、単語の移動や削除、個人リストの作成、名前の変更、並べ替え、アーカイブ、復元ができます。チャットの中でHanyuGuideのフラッシュカードを復習でき、回答はHanyuGuideアプリと同じ復習スケジュールに保存されます。辞書にない単語はHanyuGuideに追加を依頼できます。これらのツールは設定や支払いを変更できません。

es-ES.subtitle: Quiz HSK y diccionario chino
es-ES.description: Responde quizzes con palabras aleatorias de cualquier nivel de HSK 2.0 o HSK 3.0, busca palabras en chino, convierte texto a pinyin con marcas de tono y consulta los trazos de los caracteres con una cuenta de HanyuGuide, con definiciones en tu idioma. Cada quiz enlaza a la práctica con tarjetas HSK en HanyuGuide. La misma cuenta permite leer tu contexto de estudio y tus listas personales. Con permisos separados, añade palabras en bloque, mueve o elimina palabras, y crea, renombra, reordena, archiva o restaura listas personales. También puedes estudiar tus tarjetas de HanyuGuide en el chat, y cada respuesta se guarda en el mismo calendario de repasos que la app de HanyuGuide, y pedir a HanyuGuide que añada una palabra que falte en el diccionario. Estas herramientas no pueden cambiar tus preferencias ni la facturación.

hi-IN.subtitle: HSK क्विज़ और चीनी शब्दकोश
hi-IN.description: HanyuGuide खाते से HSK 2.0 या HSK 3.0 के किसी भी स्तर के यादृच्छिक शब्दों पर क्विज़ दें, चीनी शब्द खोजें, टेक्स्ट को टोन चिह्नों वाले पिनयिन में बदलें और अक्षरों के स्ट्रोक डेटा देखें, अर्थ आपकी भाषा में मिलेंगे। हर क्विज़ में HanyuGuide पर HSK फ्लैशकार्ड अभ्यास का लिंक होता है। उसी खाते से आपका अध्ययन संदर्भ और निजी सूचियाँ भी पढ़ी जा सकती हैं। अलग अनुमतियों के साथ आप एक साथ कई शब्द जोड़ सकते हैं, शब्दों को ले जा या हटा सकते हैं, और निजी सूचियाँ बना सकते हैं, उनका नाम बदल सकते हैं, क्रम बदल सकते हैं, संग्रहित या पुनर्स्थापित कर सकते हैं। आप चैट में ही HanyuGuide फ़्लैशकार्ड दोहरा सकते हैं, और हर जवाब HanyuGuide ऐप वाले उसी दोहराव शेड्यूल में सहेजा जाता है। शब्दकोश में न मिलने वाला शब्द जोड़ने के लिए HanyuGuide से अनुरोध भी कर सकते हैं। ये टूल प्राथमिकताएँ या बिलिंग नहीं बदल सकते।

fr-FR.subtitle: Quiz HSK et mots chinois
fr-FR.description: Faites des quiz sur des mots tirés au hasard de n'importe quel niveau HSK 2.0 ou HSK 3.0, cherchez des mots chinois, convertissez du texte en pinyin avec accents toniques et consultez les traits des caractères avec un compte HanyuGuide, avec des définitions dans votre langue. Chaque quiz renvoie vers l'entraînement par cartes HSK sur HanyuGuide. Le même compte permet de consulter votre contexte d'étude et vos listes personnelles. Avec des autorisations distinctes, ajoutez des mots en lot, déplacez ou retirez des mots, et créez, renommez, réordonnez, archivez ou restaurez vos listes personnelles. Vous pouvez aussi réviser vos cartes HanyuGuide directement dans la conversation, chaque réponse étant enregistrée dans le même calendrier de révisions que l’app HanyuGuide, et demander à HanyuGuide d’ajouter un mot absent du dictionnaire. Ces outils ne peuvent pas modifier vos préférences ni la facturation.

pt-BR.subtitle: Quiz HSK e dicionário chinês
pt-BR.description: Faça quizzes com palavras aleatórias de qualquer nível do HSK 2.0 ou HSK 3.0, pesquise palavras em chinês, converta texto em pinyin com marcas de tom e veja os traços dos caracteres com uma conta do HanyuGuide, com definições no seu idioma. Cada quiz leva à prática com flashcards HSK no HanyuGuide. A mesma conta permite ler seu contexto de estudo e suas listas pessoais. Com permissões separadas, adicione palavras em lote, mova ou remova palavras e crie, renomeie, reordene, arquive ou restaure listas pessoais. Você também pode estudar seus cartões do HanyuGuide no próprio chat, com cada resposta salva no mesmo cronograma de revisões do app HanyuGuide, e pedir ao HanyuGuide para adicionar uma palavra que falta no dicionário. Essas ferramentas não podem alterar suas preferências nem a cobrança.

de-DE.subtitle: HSK-Quiz & Chinesisch-Lexikon
de-DE.description: Lass dich mit einem HanyuGuide-Konto zu zufälligen Wörtern aus jeder Stufe von HSK 2.0 oder HSK 3.0 abfragen, schlage chinesische Wörter nach, wandle Text in Pinyin mit Tonzeichen um und sieh dir Strichdaten von Schriftzeichen an, mit Bedeutungen in deiner Sprache. Jedes Quiz verlinkt auf das HSK-Karteikartentraining bei HanyuGuide. Mit demselben Konto lassen sich auch dein Lernkontext und deine persönlichen Listen lesen. Mit separaten Berechtigungen kannst du Wörter gesammelt hinzufügen, Wörter verschieben oder entfernen und persönliche Listen erstellen, umbenennen, neu ordnen, archivieren oder wiederherstellen. Du kannst deine HanyuGuide-Karteikarten auch direkt im Chat lernen, jede Antwort wird im selben Wiederholungsplan wie in der HanyuGuide-App gespeichert, und HanyuGuide bitten, ein fehlendes Wort ins Wörterbuch aufzunehmen. Diese Tools können weder Einstellungen noch Abrechnung ändern.

ru-RU.subtitle: Тесты HSK и китайский словарь
ru-RU.description: Проходите тесты по случайным словам любого уровня HSK 2.0 или HSK 3.0, ищите китайские слова, переводите текст в пиньинь с тоновыми знаками и смотрите данные о чертах иероглифов с аккаунтом HanyuGuide, с переводами на вашем языке. Каждый тест ведёт к тренировке HSK по карточкам на HanyuGuide. Тот же аккаунт позволяет читать свой учебный контекст и личные списки. С отдельными разрешениями можно добавлять слова пакетами, перемещать или удалять слова, а также создавать, переименовывать, упорядочивать, архивировать и восстанавливать личные списки. Также можно повторять карточки HanyuGuide прямо в чате: каждый ответ сохраняется в то же расписание повторений, что и в приложении HanyuGuide. Можно попросить HanyuGuide добавить слово, которого нет в словаре. Эти инструменты не могут изменить настройки или оплату.
